title: Form of forms
html_source:
In Chapter 2, Stephen speaks of the soul as “form of forms”, with recourse to Aristotle’s De Anima or On the Soul.

In De Anima, “soul” is further defined as “the first grade of actuality [or entelechia] of a natural body” (Book 2, Part 1). Compare: https://genius.com/3424570/James-joyce-ulysses-chap-9-scylla-and-charybdis/Entelechy
